title: Planaria: Pattern Directed Cross-page Composite Prefetcher
problem: System cache in mobile phones suffers from low hit rates despite large on-chip area, with irregular access patterns and large working sets that neither cache replacement policies nor size increases effectively address. Traditional prefetchers cannot be applied due to the absence of program counter information on the memory side and strict power constraints.
motivation: The memory wall significantly impacts mobile phone performance, and effective system cache management is critical for user experience.
method: Planaria implements a pattern-directed prefetcher that identifies cross-page access patterns without relying on program counter information at the memory side. The approach uses composite pattern detection to predict cache misses and trigger prefetches while respecting mobile power budgets through selective prefetch traffic.
key_novelty: Pattern-directed prefetching mechanism that operates on the memory side without PC information while maintaining mobile power efficiency.
contributions: Pattern-directed cross-page prefetcher design for mobile system cache
Eliminates reliance on program counter information for memory-side prefetching
Achieves effective prefetching within mobile power constraints
Improves system cache hit rates for irregular access patterns
